name: Footer
description: Footer — breakpoints audited against ocregister.com production CSS (2026-09-18). Real production has 4 responsive states at 640px, 800px, and 1040px; 340/360 are fixed minimum-width variants kept regardless of production per design-system requirement. Columns use a masonry fill (top-to-bottom, wrap when the next item would exceed the tier's max-height) matching the live site, not a simple row-wrap grid.
